answer: Stake bonds with slashing at the mirror: each identity locks B tokens, and peer attestations are cross-checked against an on-chain beacon of historical behavior. Collateral is slashed 100% on a proven sybil link, so an attacker running n identities burns nB plus gas. At B=5000 tokens, a 50-identity farm risks 250k to earn one vote weight. The ember of any detected cluster extinguishes the whole bond set. This works because cost scales linearly with fake identities while honest stake stays single and recoverable.
